changes.title: Bot wakes sleepers
items: The bot game's player no longer gets stuck firing at a napping animal from the next area: it walks in and wakes it

changes.title: World tree sigil
items: Through the boot, the dancefloor writes the island's sigil, the World Tree, stroke by stroke as the pulse goes round the ring

changes.title: Stargazing witches
items: When a soundsystem falls, its party witch stays and lies down out past the speakers to stargaze, in pairs and threes
When the party is over, all the party witches lie looking up at the sky; keep still beside one and she will get up to chat, hold hands, hug and stargaze with you
